# Vestra Player plugin SDK 1.5.4 (@vestra-player/sdk) — reference for the AI

Made by Vestra Player AI from the SDK's README and .d.ts files (tests/vendor-sdk.mjs) until the SDK ships its own llms.txt.
{SDK} is the read-only SDK folder named in the system prompt; paths below are relative to it.

## Files

- {SDK}/README.md — overview, quick start, command line
- {SDK}/dist/plugin/types.d.ts — the whole plugin API with TSDoc and examples (search it with grep, read line ranges)
- {SDK}/dist/plugin/testing.d.ts — the test host for tests/*.test.ts: startPlugin, TestHost
- {SDK}/slint/vestra/*.slint, {SDK}/slint/palette.slint — the player's Slint library (`@vestra/theme.slint`, `@vestra/widgets.slint`, …)
- llms-full.txt (next to this file) — this index, the README and the source of the eight examples

## Examples (full source in llms-full.txt)

- hello — one menu command and an on-screen message
- blur — a tool window with one slider that blurs the video
- signal-generator — generated video and audio frames
- bookmark — a tool window bound to the playback state
- panel-menu — a sidebar panel with its own right-click menu
- menus — radio items, separator groups, a changing title
- theme-widgets — a tool window drawn with the player's theme and widgets
- markdown — a window that shows a Markdown document

## The plugin object: modules and the capability each needs

`activate(plugin)` receives a Plugin (a Scope). Each module below documents its manifest capability in parentheses.

- plugin.commands — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:140 — Menu commands and their default bindings (`commands`).
- plugin.windows — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:142 — Tool windows from `.slint` files (`ui.window`).
- plugin.panels — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:144 — Docked panels: bottom bar, sidebar and backdrop (`ui.mount`).
- plugin.dialogs — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:146 — Native file dialogs and confirmation alerts (`ui.dialog`).
- plugin.player — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:148 — Playback state and controls (`playback.read`, `events`, `playback.control`).
- plugin.video — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:155 — Video processing: this plugin's filter chain, the display layer and the GPU render options.
- plugin.audio — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:181 — Audio processing: this plugin's filter chain and delay (`processing.audio`, `playback.read` and `events`, as for VideoFilter).
- plugin.subtitles — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:192 — Subtitle tracks, uploads and style (`subtitles.read`, `subtitles.control`).
- plugin.media — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:194 — Frozen snapshots and offline exports (`media.read`, `media.control`).
- plugin.resolvers — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:196 — Page-URL to stream-URL resolvers (`source.resolve`).
- plugin.packages — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:198 — The installed plugins; validation, trials, installs (`plugins.manage` for changes).
- plugin.osd — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:200 — On-screen messages over the video (`ui.osd`).
- plugin.host — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:202 — The player's own core playback actions (`commands`).
- plugin.clipboard — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:204 — The system clipboard (`clipboard`).
- plugin.power — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:206 — Keeping the computer awake while playing (`playback.control`).
- plugin.tools — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:208 — ffmpeg / ffprobe, run by this plugin's process.
- plugin.storage — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:210 — JSON settings files in `dataDirectory`.
- plugin.system — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:212 — Show files in the file manager, open files and links.
- plugin.secrets — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:214 — Small secrets in the system's secret store (`secrets`).
- plugin.window — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:216 — The main window: fullscreen, video area, size, level, pointer hiding.
- plugin.app — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:218 — The player's version and components, and the system it runs on.
- plugin.bindings — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:220 — Every command's bindings and the user's overrides (`bindings.manage`).
- plugin.ui — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:222 — Runtime images for Slint `image` properties.
- plugin.timeline — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:224 — Marks on the seek bar, merged from every plugin's layer.
- plugin.drops — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:226 — Files dropped on the video area, by extension (`ui.drop`).
- plugin.appearance — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:228 — The player's palette.
- plugin.settings — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:230 — Pages in the player's options window (`ui.settings`).
- plugin.scope — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:235 — A child scope; disposing it releases only what was created through it.
- plugin.add — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:243 — Adopt an existing handle: it is disposed together with this scope.
- plugin.onDispose — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:257 — Run `cleanup` when this scope is disposed (for example `clearInterval` or closing a socket).
- plugin.onError — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:274 — Errors thrown by handlers that the SDK invoked (command `run`, window and panel callbacks, `onChange` listeners) in this scope.
- plugin.update — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:283 — Re-evaluate every bound value (`bind()` functions and command state functions) and send what changed.
- plugin.id — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:319 — The manifest id, e.g.
- plugin.dataDirectory — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:333 — A writable directory for this plugin's own files (settings, remembered folders).

## Capabilities (manifest `capabilities`, apiVersion `vestra/1`)

`producer.av`, `playback.read`, `playback.control`, `source.resolve`, `events`, `commands`, `ui.window`, `ui.mount`, `ui.dialog`, `plugins.manage`, `processing.video`, `processing.audio`, `subtitles.read`, `subtitles.control`, `media.read`, `media.control`, `ui.osd`, `clipboard`, `window.control`, `bindings.manage`, `timeline.marks`, `ui.drop`, `ui.settings`, `ui.theme`, `secrets`

## Every declaration (read the line range with `read` before using it)

- interface Disposable — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:43 — Anything that owns player-side or local resources: every handle the API returns (commands, windows, panels, filters, snapshots, listeners…).
- type PluginError — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:100 — Every API failure is an ordinary `Error` with a stable string `code`.
- interface Scope — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:138 — A group of handles released together.
- interface Plugin — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:317 — The object the player passes to a plugin's `activate`: the root Scope, plus the plugin's identity and data directory.
- interface CommandState — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:336 — The state of a command's menu item, as the player shows it.
- type Bindable — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:361 — A value, or a function the SDK re-evaluates on every update pass (see Scope.update); only changes are sent to the player.
- type MenuId — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:368 — A built-in top-level menu of the player, named in a command path as `@<id>` (see CommandOptions.path): Open (打开), Playback (播放), Subtitles (字幕), Video (视频), Au…
- interface CommandOptions — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:398 — The declaration passed to Commands.add.
- interface Command — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:481 — A registered command, from Commands.add.
- interface Commands — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:505 — `plugin.commands`: menu commands with default bindings.
- interface ImageRef — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:558 — An image file for a Slint `image` property, made by Ui.image.
- interface MarkdownRef — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:593 — A Markdown document for `MarkdownView` or `MarkdownBlocks`, made by Ui.markdown.
- interface MarkdownOptions — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:606 — Options of Ui.markdown: where relative links and images point, and whether remote images are downloaded.
- type PropValue — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:648 — The value of one Slint property: JSON with Markdown documents at any depth (PropData), or an image as the whole value of an `image` property.
- type PropData — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:663 — JSON whose values may also be Markdown documents, at any depth: the part of PropValue that nests.
- type Props — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:683 — Properties to write to a view, by name.
- interface Ui — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:710 — Values for Slint properties that are not plain JSON: images from files and Markdown documents.
- interface View — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:843 — The surface that tool windows, panels and settings pages share: properties out to Slint, callbacks in from Slint.
- interface Window — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:1022 — A tool window: a separate operating-system window drawn from one of the plugin's `.slint` files, made by Windows.create.
- interface Windows — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:1182 — Create tool windows: separate windows drawn from the plugin's `.slint` files.
- interface SlotState — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:1232 — The state of the bottom bar or sidebar position, whoever mounted the panel there.
- interface SlotPanel — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:1258 — One panel of a position (PanelSlot.panels): a tab of the sidebar.
- interface PanelState — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:1273 — The state of one panel (Panel.state): its position's state, seen from this panel, which may be one of several sidebar tabs.
- interface PanelSlot — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:1325 — The bottom bar or the sidebar position (`plugin.panels.bottom`, `plugin.panels.sidebar`), independent of who mounted the panel there.
- interface SidebarSlot — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:1485 — The sidebar position: a PanelSlot that can also float in a window of its own.
- interface Panel — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:1542 — A panel in the player's main window, made by Panels.mount.
- interface DropModifiers — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:1792 — Keys held when the files were dropped.
- interface DropHandler — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:1801 — A provider for files dropped on the video area (Drops.provide).
- interface Drops — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:1814 — `plugin.drops`: files dropped on the video area.
- type ThemeId — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:1853 — The player's palettes: `vestra`, the dark default, and `vestra-light` (player 0.4.0, SDK 1.5.0), a light palette whose video area stays dark.
- interface Appearance — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:1889 — The player's palette, which every view uses.
- type SettingsCategory — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:1953 — The categories of the Options window.
- type SettingsPage — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2033 — A page in the player's Options window, made by Settings.page.
- interface Settings — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2089 — Add pages to the player's Options window.
- interface BackdropSlot — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2195 — The backdrop position (`plugin.panels.backdrop`): whether a backdrop is mounted and whether it is shown now.
- interface Panels — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2260 — Put a panel into the player's main window: the bottom bar, the sidebar or the backdrop.
- type MarkKind — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2338 — What a timeline mark stands for; readers choose colours by it.
- interface TimelineMark — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2340 — One mark on the seek bar.
- interface TimelineLayer — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2351 — This plugin's own marks; disposing it removes them.
- interface Timeline — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2379 — `plugin.timeline`: marks on the seek bar.
- interface WindowState — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2388 — The main window as `plugin.window.state` reports it (logical points).
- interface MainWindow — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2431 — The player's main window.
- interface AppInfo — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2491 — `plugin.app`: fixed for the life of the plugin process.
- interface App — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2516 — `plugin.app`: the fixed facts plus the system, read on request.
- interface SystemInfo — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2524 — What App.system reports.
- interface DisplayInfo — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2541 — One display in SystemInfo.displays.
- interface ConfirmOptions — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2562 — Options of Dialogs.confirm.
- interface Dialogs — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2625 — The system's own dialogs: a confirmation alert and the open and save file dialogs.
- interface AudioTrack — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2782 — One audio track of the current media (PlayerState.audioTracks).
- interface PlayerState — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2804 — An immutable view of the player.
- interface AudioDevice — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2881 — An audio output device (`player.audioDevices`).
- interface Chapter — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2888 — One chapter of the current media.
- interface Conditional — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2910 — Controls act on the state you are looking at: by default `player.state`.
- interface Media — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2915 — A source this plugin opened.
- interface Scrub — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2944 — A drag gesture: each seek is conditional on the previous one, latest value wins.
- interface StreamFrame — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2967 — Frames a stream supplies on demand: RGBA pixels and 48 kHz stereo f32 PCM.
- interface StreamOptions — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2978 — Options of Player.openStream.
- type StreamStartError — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2993 — `openStream` start-up timeouts: code `timeout` with the step that ran out of time, the first buffers (`prefill`) or the host's activation.
- interface Stream — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:2998 — A generated source, from Player.openStream.
- interface SequenceProvider — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3018 — The plugin that owns "next / previous" (a playlist).
- interface PlaybackStats — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3032 — What Player.stats reports.
- interface Player — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3117 — `plugin.player`: playback state and controls.
- type HostAction — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3290 — The core's basic playback actions (menu commands owned by the player).
- interface Host — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3292 — `plugin.host`: the player's own core actions.
- interface OsdPanel — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3332 — This plugin's information block on the OSD: multi-line text over the video that stays until the plugin changes or removes it.
- interface Osd — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3387 — Text the player draws over the video: short messages and an information block.
- type FilterStatus — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3441 — The state of a filter, display layer or render options handle.
- interface Filter — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3470
- type VideoFilter — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3511 — This plugin's own video processing chain, re-applied for every new source.
- type AudioFilter — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3527 — This plugin's own audio chain plus its audio delay in 10 ms steps.
- interface ViewSettings — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3537 — How the video sits in the video area; not part of snapshots or exports.
- interface VideoView — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3566 — The display layer, from `plugin.video.view()` (`processing.video`).
- interface RenderSettings — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3578 — GPU renderer options; not part of snapshots or exports.
- interface RenderOptions — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3609 — The GPU renderer's options, from `plugin.video.render()` (`processing.video`).
- interface SubtitleTrack — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3621 — A subtitle track of the current source.
- interface SubtitlesState — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3649 — The subtitle state of the current source.
- interface SubtitleConditional — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3677 — Subtitle calls act on the selection you see; pass `ifCurrent` to pin an older one.
- interface Subtitles — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3699 — `plugin.subtitles`: tracks, uploads and style.
- interface CaptureOptions — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3740 — Options of MediaCapture.capture.
- interface Snapshot — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3751 — A frozen, immutable input for exports.
- type ExportOptions — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3786 — One frame as PNG, JPEG (`quality` 1–100, default 90) or BMP (24-bit), or a clip as MP4.
- type JobState — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3816 — An export job's state.
- interface ExportJob — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3818 — An export, from Snapshot.export.
- interface MediaCapture — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3850 — `plugin.media`: snapshots and exports.
- type ResolverOptions — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3862 — Declaration of Resolvers.add: a web resolver (WebResolverOptions) or a file resolver (FileResolverOptions).
- interface WebResolverOptions — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3864 — A resolver for web pages: `https://host/…` to playable stream URLs.
- interface FileResolverOptions — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3924 — A resolver for local files by extension (SDK 1.5.3, player 0.4.1): when anyone opens such a file with Player.open (the Open dialog, the playlist, next / previo…
- interface ResolvedStream — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3940 — What a file resolver returns: a stream, with the same frame contract as StreamOptions (size limits, `frame()` on the audio clock).
- interface Resolver — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3958 — A registered resolver.
- interface Resolvers — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:3986 — `plugin.resolvers`: turn web page URLs into playable streams, or local files into streams this plugin generates.
- interface PackageManifest — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:4001 — The manifest of a package, as validated.
- type PackageSource — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:4041 — Where an installed plugin came from.
- interface InstallOptions — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:4062 — Options of PackageCandidate.install.
- interface PackageCandidate — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:4077 — A validated package directory, from Packages.validate.
- interface PackageTrial — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:4097 — A trial load of a package.

- interface PackageChange — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:4113 — An install, rollback or uninstall in progress.
- interface PluginInfo — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:4126 — One plugin as the player knows it (`packages.list`).
- interface PluginWarning — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:4172 — One refusal in PluginInfo.warnings.

- interface Clipboard — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:4312 — The system clipboard (`clipboard`).
- interface Power — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:4321 — Keeping the computer awake (`playback.control`).
- interface ToolResult — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:4335 — The output of Tools.run.
- interface Tools — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:4357 — `plugin.tools`: ffmpeg and ffprobe, run in this plugin's process.
- interface JsonStore — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:4378 — A JSON file `dataDirectory/<name>.json`, loaded once and saved debounced.
- interface Storage — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:4390 — `plugin.storage`: JSON settings files.
- interface System — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:4427 — `plugin.system`: files and links, executed by the player.
- interface Secrets — dist/plugin/types.d.ts:4461 — Per-plugin secrets (API keys, passwords) in the system's secret store: the login keychain on macOS, the Credential Manager on Windows.

- interface FakeProducer — dist/plugin/testing.d.ts:111 — A generated stream (`plugin.player.openStream`) as the test host sees it: the fake player end of the frame connection.
